verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows account-level features (unique account numbers for matching incoming payments, webhook/event tracking of payment status, holds, FDIC-insured partner banks) but nothing documenting a daily reconciliation process between Increase's own ledger and the actual bank-held balances at its partner banks (First Internet Bank/Blue Ridge Bank per increase-comm-1) — the specific control that failed in the Synapse collapse. No mention of audited ledger-to-bank matching, attestations, or reconciliation reporting is present anywhere in the docs or community items.
